import re
import sys

text = sys.stdin.read()
values = {}

pattern = re.compile(
    r'\b(TMP|[a-h])\s*<-\s*'
    r'(?:\(\s*(TMP|[a-h])\s*\+\s*(\d+)\s*\)\s*mod\s*100|(\d+))'
)

for match in pattern.finditer(text):
    target, source, increment, literal = match.groups()
    if literal is not None:
        values[target] = int(literal)
    else:
        values[target] = (values[source] + int(increment)) % 100

names = list("abcdefgh") + ["TMP"]
print(" ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]};" for name in names))
